title: AFX CLI configuration (~/.afx/afx.config.json)
description: Every key is optional; an unset key uses the built-in neutral default (no organisation, no hub repo, generic folders). Resolution order: $AFX_CONFIG, then ~/.afx/afx.config.json, then the tenant preset afx-config.afx.json next to the scripts if that private file is present, then the neutral built-ins. Written by `afx init`.

org.description: GitHub organisation (or user) that owns your repos.

extraOrgs.description: Further GitHub owners whose repos count as yours (besides org).

hubRepo.description: owner/repo of the repo that holds the guard scripts; afx-bootstrap.sh fetches from it.

clonesRootMac.description: Where project clones live on macOS. A leading ~ is your home folder.

clonesRootWindows.description: Where project clones live on Windows (Git Bash).

registryFile.description: The project registry (key, path, name per project).

brand.description: Name shown in briefings and menus.

quickstartDoc.description: Where `afx brief` points agents for the full guide.

enabledModules.description: Which modules from modules.json are active: "all" or a list of module names.

policyPacks.description: Rule packs the policy guard loads.
